mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS resultId, r.session_id AS sessionId, r.source_text AS sourceText, r.translated_text AS translatedText, r.speaker_name AS speakerName FROM interpretation_result r LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON r.id = e.result_id WHERE e.id IS NULL AND r.source_text IS NOT NULL AND r.source_text != '' LIMIT #{limit}
